# opnsense_dhcrelay_relay (Resource)

DHCP relays (**Services ▸ DHCP Relay ▸ Relays**), one per interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_dhcrelay_destination" "central" {
  name   = "central-dhcp"
  server = ["10.0.0.67"]
}

resource "opnsense_dhcrelay_relay" "guests" {
  interface   = "opt2"
  destination = opnsense_dhcrelay_destination.central.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) ID of the `opnsense_dhcrelay_destination` to relay to.
- `interface` (String) Interface DHCP requests are relayed from.

### Optional

- `agent_info` (Boolean) Append the relay agent information option (82). Defaults to `false`.
- `carp_depend_on` (String) CARP VIP the relay follows; it only runs while that VIP is master.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the relay is enabled. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the DHCP relay.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import opnsense_dhcrelay_relay using the `id`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_dhcrelay_relay.example
  id = "<opnsense-resource-id>"
}
```

Using `terraform import`, import opnsense_dhcrelay_relay using the `id`. For example:

```console
% terraform import opnsense_dhcrelay_relay.example <opnsense-resource-id>
```
